# Archived prompts — 2026-06-04

These four prompt files were superseded as part of the slash-command surface-area reduction:

| Archived file | Superseded by |
|---|---|
| `ai-branch.prompt.md` | `/ai-git branch` |
| `ai-commit.prompt.md` | `/ai-git commit` (default subcommand) |
| `ai-pr.prompt.md` | `/ai-git pr` |
| `ai-import-project.prompt.md` | `/ai-onboard` (now detects existing projects and walks the import path automatically) |

Authoritative replacement: [`.github/prompts/ai-git.prompt.md`](../../ai-git.prompt.md) and [`.github/prompts/ai-onboard.prompt.md`](../../ai-onboard.prompt.md).

Archived per [`.ai/archive-protocol.md`](../../../../.ai/archive-protocol.md) (never-delete rule).
